context: Small script (node or python) in the canonical repo that validates lock-vs-tree and manifest-vs-lock coverage; wire as a required GitHub Actions check on PRs to main.
description: skill-sync-skills invariant (c) (docs/propagation.md) requires skill-sync.lock to be regenerated in the same commit as any skill edit, but nothing enforces it: PRs #9 and #10 merged skill edits (SHARED/commit-framework, SHARED/review-protocol) with stale lock hashes, silently breaking lock integrity on main until PR #11 repaired the instances. The class remains unguarded — the repo has no CI and no pre-commit hook. Add a mechanical gate (GitHub Actions job and/or pre-commit) that recomputes sha256/size for every lock entry against the tree and fails on mismatch or on skills present in skill-sync.yaml but absent from the lock (the accidental-docs-drop class, fixed as instance in PR #11). Discovered 2026-07-29 during the docs-skill restoration.
